summary: Recorded phased application dates as separate milestones, taken from each entry's existing text. No date changed.
Added Illinois SB 315, the California AI Transparency Act and Executive Order 14409. Updated the New York RAISE Act for its March 2026 chapter amendment.
Recorded the supersession of EO 14110 and OMB M-24-10 on their successors as well, so both sides of each link show it.
Added the TAKE IT DOWN Act, the first federal statute placing AI-related duties on private platforms.
Full dataset review. Added 15 entries from 2025 and 2026 and corrected 15, including the repeal of Colorado SB 24-205, the expiry of Canada's AIDA and the supersession of OMB M-24-10.
First release: 28 entries across US federal, US state and international law.
